title: Fixed coefficient realization preserves finite pullback composition
statement: For the finite operation datum S of def-sf-operation-stages and composable f:X→Y and g:Y→Z, let R_X be the coordinates functor of def-sf-finite-projection-fixed-coordinates and p_f(M) the fixedPullRealization isomorphism of def-sf-constructible-projection-mates. For every bounded constructible M at Z, R_X(S.finite.pullComposition(f,g)_M) followed by p_f(S.finite.pull(g)M) and fixedDerivedPull(f)(p_g(M)) equals p_(f≫g)(M) followed by the canonical fixed-scalar leftDerivedUpperStarComp(f,g) at R_Z(M). This asserts compatibility of the specified compositors, without tensor products or a finite-Tor hypothesis.

proof.text: Apply the inverse coefficient realization at X to S.finitePullCompositionNormalization f g M, then expand fixedPullRealization and pullRealization. Move the comparison for g through the comparison for f by naturality.

Expand sfIntrinsicDerivedPullbackComp as the derived natural isomorphism of sfIntrinsicPullbackComp followed by mapDerivedCategoryCompIso. Associativity, naturality under whiskering and mapDerivedCategoryNatIso compatibility identify its coefficient-conjugated image with the fixed-scalar exact compositor. The middle unit inserted by sfIntrinsicTransportComp cancels the inverse unit in fixedPullRealization; the equivalence triangle identities cancel the endpoint factors.

Expand leftDerivedUpperStarComp through leftDerivedFunctorNatIso and leftDerivedFunctorCompIso, and cancel the exact-to-left-derived comparison factors fixedPullComparison. The remaining equality is precisely the statement, with its given finite and fixed-scalar compositors.

theorem pullbackComposition_fixed_coordinates
    (S : SixFunctorFiniteOperations D C E n hn)
    {X Y Z : SixFunctorSpace D} (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z)
    (M : sixFunctorFiniteCategory D C E n hn Z) :
    let A := ModuleCat.{u + 1}
      (ULift.{u + 1} (Padic.coefficientExtensionRing C.l E n))
    (coordinates (C := C) (E := E) (n := n) (hn := hn) X).map
        ((S.finite.pullComposition f g).hom.app M) ≫
      (fixedPullRealization S f ((S.finite.pull g).obj M)).hom ≫
      (fixedDerivedPull (C := C) (E := E) (n := n) f).map
        (fixedPullRealization S g M).hom =
    (fixedPullRealization S (f ≫ g) M).hom ≫
      (AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.leftDerivedUpperStarComp A f.hom.left g.hom.left).hom.app
        ((coordinates (C := C) (E := E) (n := n) (hn := hn) Z).obj M)
